goals.title: Ship the Momus-approved Next Move Report MVP pivot in .omo/plans/next...
goals.objective: Ship the Momus-approved Next Move Report MVP pivot in .omo/plans/next-move-report-mvp.md end to end: implement the 12 planned tasks across 8 waves, keep the primary MVP route at /relationship/contact-timing, introduce next_move_report_mvp_v1 while preserving legacy relationship sources, rebrand acquisition to Next Move Report, provide a free contact-or-wait verdict before the paywall, align the paid full report to USD 9 Stripe, treat Saju/tarot/astrology only as optional evidence layers, hide but do not delete legacy CosmicPath acquisition surfaces, update trust/legal/ops/SEO/English-probe surfaces, preserve existing API shapes unless the plan explicitly requires a small helper, and prove completion with task-level RED-to-GREEN evidence plus real browser/HTTP QA artifacts.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser use: start dev server at http://localhost:3100, open /relationship/contact-timing, verify first viewport contains Next Move Report, 연락할까, 기다릴까, 첫 판정 무료, $9; click primary CTA; verify /start keeps entry=next_move_report_mvp_v1 and prefilled question; continue to free verdict and verify verdict/evidence/next-action appears before paid report. Automated pair: tests/e2e/next-move-report.spec.ts test ids "mvp route is branded and routes to start", "start keeps Next Move source and prefilled question", chromium+mobile full spec.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/criterion-C001-happy-browser.txt plus screenshots .omo/evidence/criterion-C001-route.png, .omo/evidence/criterion-C001-start.png, .omo/evidence/criterion-C001-result.png; RED outputs .omo/evidence/task-{1..12}-*-red.txt; GREEN outputs .omo/evidence/task-{1..12}-*-green.txt; cleanup receipt must include dev server PID killed or reused server unchanged and browser context closed.
successCriteria.notes: Happy browser flow plus direct unmocked /api/reading free_focus evidence passed; desktop and mobile Playwright specs passed after final fixes.

successCriteria.scenario: HTTP call + Browser use: curl -i http://localhost:3100/api/payment/price with no productId and curl -i http://localhost:3100/api/payment/price?productId=reading, expecting graceful JSON/fallback and no $3.99; then open /start?reset=true&context=love&entry=next_move_report_mvp_v1&question= with an empty question and verify no crash/error overlay and relationship decision copy still appears. Automated pair: scripts/verify-stability-guards.cjs Next Move safety/price invariants plus tests/e2e/next-move-report.spec.ts test id "start handles empty Next Move question safely".
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/criterion-C002-edge-http.txt and .omo/evidence/criterion-C002-empty-question.png; RED outputs .omo/evidence/task-6-safety-red.txt and .omo/evidence/task-7-price-red.txt; GREEN outputs .omo/evidence/task-6-safety-green.txt and .omo/evidence/task-7-price-green.txt; cleanup receipt must include dev server PID killed or reused server unchanged and browser context closed.
successCriteria.notes: Additional reviewer blocker fix: paywall pauses checkout on READING_PRICE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH; Task 2 GREEN evidence includes .omo/evidence/task-2-e2e-green.txt and .omo/evidence/task-2-stability-green.txt.

successCriteria.scenario: HTTP call + Browser use + CLI stdout: curl -I /daily, /daily/tarot, /k-destiny, /oracle-chat, /en/saju, /career/uncertainty to prove legacy routes are hidden but not deleted; open / and verify primary nav/mobile menu do not expose legacy fortune/subscription/PRO links; open /ops/growth or use source checks to verify next_move_report_mvp_v1 groups with relationship_contact_timing_v1 and en_relationship_contact_timing_v1; curl /terms and /privacy to verify relationship/optional evidence/USD Stripe/refund boundaries. Automated pair: npm test, npm run verify:stability, npm run lint, npm run build, tests/e2e/next-move-report.spec.ts test ids "home and nav contain only MVP acquisition", "legacy routes remain directly reachable", and "ops groups Next Move with relationship history".
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/criterion-C003-regression-http.txt, .omo/evidence/criterion-C003-home-desktop.png, .omo/evidence/criterion-C003-home-mobile.png, .omo/evidence/criterion-C003-growth.txt, .omo/evidence/criterion-C003-legal.txt; GREEN outputs for npm test, verify:stability, lint, build, chromium and mobile e2e; cleanup receipt must include dev server PID killed or reused server unchanged, browser context closed, no tmux/session/port leftovers.
successCriteria.notes: Legacy/legal/growth/browser regression evidence passed after JSON-LD and legal HTTP fixes; build/lint/test/stability and desktop/mobile Playwright passed.
